description.en: A debug-only parameter getter. In this build its implementation is a stub that ignores its argument and always reports 0, regardless of what parameter is requested.
Read but not used — the stub ignores it and always returns 0.
Always 0 on a valid call; null if no paramId argument was given.

example.code:
// Debug-only helper; always returns 0 in this build regardless of the parameter requested
local debugValue = DBGCMND_GET_PARAM(0);
